# Migration From ArcPy

## Legacy implementation

The legacy repo used:

- `arcpy`
- ArcGIS Pro project artifacts
- notebooks with embedded production logic

## Modern target

The modern branch moves to:

- configuration-driven pipelines
- package modules in `src/`
- open-source geospatial processing
- Quarto maintainer docs

## Replacement mapping

- `PairwiseDissolve` -> `GeoDataFrame.dissolve`
- `SpatialJoin_analysis` -> `geopandas.sjoin`
- file geodatabase outputs -> GeoPackage and GeoParquet
- notebook business logic -> importable Python modules
